title: Government Powers and Limitations - 1st Edition
description: This volume focuses on constitutional doctrine and law in the areas of government powers and limitations. It includes excerpts of landmark cases related to the judiciary and executive, contracts and takings clauses, and due process. The excerpts include the constitutional issues in these cases that are related to government powers and limitations with other questions of law and dicta omitted.
authors: Kimberly Clairmont - Author / Ethan Derstine - Author / Alexandria Metzdorf - Author / Stella Kemp - Author / Gabriel Thomison - Author / Eduardo Vidal - Author / Walter DePuy - Author / Rorie Spill Solberg - Editor
